verdict.rationale: Drata publishes its own browsable OpenAPI-based v2 API reference at developers.drata.com, organized by tag (Personnel, Devices, Controls, Policies, Risks, Audits, Custom Connections, Monitoring Tests, Evidence Library, Frameworks) and listing create/list/update/delete endpoints. The reference itself is well evidenced. Nothing in the pack shows that it is interactive or offers runnable examples, and probes found no raw OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. missing for 10: evidence of a try-it/runnable request console, runnable code samples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec download, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
